item.title: Top House Dem dismisses probe into Jasmine Crockett’s security guard killed in SWAT standoff
item.summary: Rep. Pete Aguilar questioned whether Congress should probe Rep. Jasmine Crockett hiring a convicted criminal for her taxpayer-funded security detail.

item.title: Political traffic signals: waiting for the light to change on the Hill
item.summary: Congress faces a steep political battle over a $200 billion Iran war spending request, with Trump sending mixed signals on whether the funds are needed.

item.title: Trump's death will be 'like Mardi Gras in New Orleans,' Charlamagne warns after Mueller post
item.summary: Radio host Charlamagne Tha God warned President Donald Trump that people will celebrate his death "like Mardi Gras" after he celebrated Robert Mueller's death.

item.title: Bill Cosby found liable for 1972 sexual assault, jury awards $59.25M to accuser
item.summary: A Santa Monica jury found fallen comedian Bill Cosby liable of drugging and sexually assaulting Donna Motsinger in 1972, and awarded the former waitress more than $19 million in damages.

item.title: Megan Moroney stuns in orange bikini during friend's Bahamas bachelorette
item.summary: Megan Moroney hits the Bahamas for a friend's bachelorette trip and reveals she's covering Hannah Montana's 'Best of Both Worlds' for Spotify Singles.

item.title: Federal officer in critical condition after DC shooting as authorities search for answers
item.summary: A US Park Police officer was shot in SE Washington, D.C., and is critically wounded, with FBI Director Kash Patel vowing to find those responsible.

item.title: Obama adviser reveals private conversations urging Biden not to run in 2016
item.summary: The University of Virginia’s Miller Center published an interview with Obama strategist David Plouffe, who was tasked with informing Biden that he should not run for president in 2016.

item.title: Mullin confirmed as DHS chief as lawmakers near solution on shutdown standoff
item.summary: Even with a new DHS chief, Senate Democrats aren't backing down from their demands for stringent reforms to ICE. And now President Donald Trump wants to pair funding with voter ID legislation.

item.title: NJ man crawls through window, attempts to sexually assault girl before being subdued by resident: police
item.summary: A New Jersey resident is being credited with stopping a horrific home invasion after subduing a suspect who allegedly tried to sexually assault a sleeping girl.

item.title: Johnson turns up heat on Schumer as DHS shutdown drags on, airport delays mount
item.summary: As the DHS shutdown enters its sixth week, House Republicans are forcing votes to pressure Senate Democrats. Meanwhile, unpaid TSA agents call out, leaving travelers facing chaos.
